modification_description: Add an explicit time-and-harm constraint requiring the family to pursue alternative access routes immediately (school/device loan programs, library/lab access, community initiatives, used/refurbished options only if they don't force cuts to essentials) rather than delaying, because prolonged lack of access can quickly worsen learning gaps. The synthesis should be tightened to: short-term educational access must be pursued without delay, while absolutely preserving housing, food, utilities, healthcare, and transportation.
